notes.title: Codename Panzers Franchise now available!
notes.notes:
Dear Nordic Games fans,

while Codename Panzers: Cold War has already been live on Steam for quite some time, we are now happy to announce, that Codename Panzers Phase 1 as well as Phase 2 and the Soundtracks for all 3 games have found their ways online on Steam.

We have also published a new Codename Panzers Bundle offering all 3 titles and their Soundtracks for a really special price.

Check it out!

Codename Panzers Phase One:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/411310/

Codename Panzers Phase Two:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/411320/

Codename Panzers Cold War:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/9850/

Cheers
Your Nordic Games Team

notes.title: Patch that disables Tages activation is live
notes.notes:
Hello, 

I just set a patch live that completely disables Tages. This way the game should work smoothly on all possible systems that are withing the system requirements. Problems with activation and on certain systems (windows 7/8 and x64 systems) should be completely gone now. 

Have fun!
